Maya: Escalating Velora pilot - onboarding webhooks failing intermittently during bulk import. Support ticket CSUP-88888. Customer concerned about demo next week and renewal.

Owen: Can you paste an error snippet and region?

Maya: ```504: gateway_timeout - step=webhook-callback - tx=c3f2 - at=2026-03-26T08:12:10Z``` us-east-1.

Priya: Looks like worker saturation + retry storms. Short-term: set async_enqueue for account=velora-21 and enable priority queue. Long-term: increase webhook worker pool and add client backoff guidance.

Sam: I'll apply async_enqueue + priority now and monitor. ETA visible in ~20 mins.

Maya: Customer prefers 11am ET tomorrow for an enablement session. Please keep renewal_watch for 30 days if issues continue.

Owen: Patch for client retries ready, pushing link after tests.

Sam: Temp changes applied: async_enqueue=true, priority=high for velora-21; revert window=48h. Monitoring dashboards updated.

Priya: I'll draft the enablement checklist (bulk import best practices, retry/backoff snippet, preflight checks).

Maya: Thanks team. Adding note to CSUP-88888 with debug bundle and schedule. Will update after the enablement call.
